I’ve had a lovely past month at Embrace Sober House! I arrived with the idea to give myself more time to get used to recovery and to test myself in a safe environment whilst striving to socialize and spend time around other people working on their recovery! I got this and so much more! I found a place of open minded and caring people! The staff have many years of sobriety are were always open to share their experience! The many activities organized were always lots of fun and very enjoyable! The facilities are well cared for and the atmosphere is magical! Healing in nature whilst enjoying great comfort! The rooms are cleaned every day and the staff is very professional! They make an extra effort into safety and making sure that the place stays a sober house! I was tested 2 x a week and felt very safe / cared for! Knowing that a place like this exists in the world gives me a lot of comfort!
Thank you soo much for everything you’ve done for me!

I was lucky enough to have had a counselor in primary treatment who knew about Embrace and recommended I go there post-rehab. Following that recommendation and coming to Embrace, where I spent seven incredible months, solidified my early recovery journey — mainly because the highly approachable and professional staff, the programming, the activities, and my fellow clients kept me from long periods of dangerous isolation and rumination, which I was prone to at the time — and it may well have saved my life. I wish more people in early recovery, especially those who come to Thailand for treatment, knew about Embrace as a place to get strong and confident, to safely and happily transition back to normal life. It has therefore become a personal priority of mine to spread the word. NJ

text: My stay at Embrace was truly life changing. Travelling from London by myself in my 50s was so daunting but all completely worth it. I was met at the airport with such a warm welcome. My room was sooooo lovely and spacious. I particularly enjoyed the fun-packed schedule and I always had a choice to join every day. Which I did because I didn’t want to miss anything they offered. I liked the family community feeling of the place and the group really felt like a real support network. The community had all shared experiences and were free of addiction and truly enjoying life. We done so much together, cycling, visiting temples, elephants, Muay Thai, yoga, swimming, bamboo rafting, gorgeous meals out and cooking meals together, meditation, AA and NA, massage, barbecues, chess, hiking, shopping, markets and so much more. I really loved the staff. The therapy counsellors and recovery coach were real quality and delivered very educational sessions. I found out a lot about how my mind ticks. I haven’t laughed so much in years. I actually didn’t want to leave. I could have lived there forever, but the experience Embrace gave me was the tools to thrive back in my own life. I will definitely keep returning though. I am absolutely in love with Chiang Mai. It will always have a place in my heart.

Embrace sober house is the gold standard for secondary treatment. I had a wonderful experience there as it is a great stepping stone after completing rehab. People usually make the mistake of comparing a sober house to a rehabilitation center, and get disappointed when sober houses do not offer the same programs and schedules they had from primary treatment. Embrace offers you a a comparatively (more) simplified schedule, various informative workshops and top quality support workers, so as to give you more opportunities to explore your own autonomy. From the safety of embrace sober house, one gets to craft a new lifestyle while being afforded genuine care and counsel by the team. I would highly recommend Embrace to anyone transitioning out of primary treatment into the real world as it is a great place for discovering one’s own identity in recovery.

Amazing sober living space. Was a great mix of being able to integrate back into every day life whilst receiving excellent support through the support team, interns and therapy staff, all excellent and would highly recommend to anyone leaving rehab in Thailand or in need of a reset.

Embrace Sober House 🌟

After careful deliberation with myself and those closest to me, the decision was made for me to go to Embrace. Ever since I made that decision, I haven’t looked back.

Embrace gave me a support network that has allowed me to reintegrate back into society, and build a strong foundation for my recovery whilst doing so. My recent stay at Embrace Sober House in Chiang Mai was integral to maintaining my sobriety after Primary treatment. I felt supported and genuinely cared for in an environment that allowed me both structure and autonomy to practice my new found sobriety skills. The group sessions and lectures were so beneficial. The accommodation was very comfortable and private. I made friendships here that made the experience especially memorable. Thank You Embrace!

My son was in Embrace from July 2022 and all the support help and advice that he got from the team there is the best that one would expect for their son.
We are a small family and unfortunately my son was suffering with addiction of drugs and alcohol. We seeked advice from others and found that Embrace is the right place for him. The support that he got from the staff and the counselling staff helping him through his journey with his recovery was to a very high standard.
We have always had a very good rapport with all the staff and they were very supportive and helpful and our communication was very good and they went out to all lengths to help us and keep us posted about our son’s progress.
We cannot thank Embrace enough again for all the support and encouragement that they have given to both my son and for my family.
I would like to add that my son is doing very well towards his recovery and has found employment nearby and still has the support of Embrace for any problems that he might encounter in his recovery
We as a family from England are very grateful to Embrace and their entire team. Unfortunately I will not name any names in a review but you know who you are and thank you all very much again.
If you have got anyone who was in my son’s condition I have no reservations but to recommend that they come to Embrace and get all the help and professional support and we highly recommend this facility for anyone.
We are very happy with the care support and help that they have given to not only my son but to my entire family.

I arrived at Embrace after three months in a primary treatment facility. Not quite sure of how to integrate back into life and still needing support it was an easy choice to make as the next step in my recovery journey.

Embrace came very highly recommended and is leading in the field of secondary treatments, upon my own queries the program and structure was exactly what I was looking for.

I stayed with embrace for 5 months, going through the program too the best of my ability, which was up and down there were good days and bad yet throughout I never felt pressured to do or be anything other than what I was capable of and most of all I felt completely supported.

The therapeutic program is perfectly rounded three days of the week contain informative groups led by experts in the field of addiction, mental health and personal growth. Alternate days there are community activities ranging from hikes in the mountains of Chiang Mai to painting classes in the ancient temples in the Old City. I also particularly loved the water park and go karting.

Whilst there is always something to do with the community, you are never forced, I found sometimes I would need some personal space for me this was an opportunity to  explore the area on one of the provided bikes or simply go and get a relaxing massage to unwind.

A huge shout out to my counsellor at Embrace Eléonore King who I still work with to this day giving me such amazing insight on anxiety, fear, self discovery and a new lens on who I am and what I am capable of.

Whilst at Embrace I was solely able to focus on my next steps in recovery, I planned my goals with my recovery coach Phil who guided me amazingly throughout my time, sharing his own experiences to best equip me in my own journey. I worked on my fitness with Dan Sully who leads personal boxing classes and is an amazing human being. Dan Noble was also an amazing support to me when ever I was not 100% he was always around to lend an ear and mentorship. I wouldn't have been able stay in the country if it hadn't been for Mark C. the seamless transitions of boarder runs and organising trips to immigration was a luxury which really is appreciated.

All of the staff at embrace made me feel safe, supported and cared for. I genuinely felt like I was coming back home at the end of each day.

Henk and Bill run a very professional program. They are dedicated to each and every person who comes through the doors at embrace. This is evident to me since leaving, Embrace has maintained regular communication and continued to support me on my journey.

I cannot make assumptions on where I might be if I hadn't spent these 5 months at Embrace, I can however say I would never of had the opportunity that I have now, the structure and routine in my life, the deep personal understanding and most importantly to me the connection with myself and others in this tight nit community that Embrace creates.

I thank each and every person at embrace. I can not speak highly enough for what this place has done for my life.

The program is all encompassing and very engaging, ensuring that there is a variety of treatments and techniques on offer. The staff are great at encouraging and advising on activities and daily practises, they have made my experience a very warm and positive journey- all whilst maintaining the utmost respect for privacy and professionalism. I truly owe a great amount to the people of Embrace Sober House, spending time there  was the best decision I have made for my recovery.

The staff are absolutely awesome and made me feel at home straight away, I made alot of good friends and was pleasantly surprised with my room, the bed is …

I simply cannot recommend Embrace and their staff highly enough for those working towards independent sober living.  A family member undertook +3 months of secondary residential care at Embrace and the progress they have made in their life through a combination of abstinence-based therapy, recovery coaching, counselling and loving support from the staff at Embrace has changed theirs and our lives forever.  Embrace offers a respectful and structured environment for those willing to rebuild their lives from often very dark places.  As a family, we are forever grateful to Henk, Mark and the whole team at Embrace for what they have given to our family member.  Words cannot praise Embrace highly enough.  Thank you.

I went to Embrace Sober House in the beautiful Chiang Mai in July after completing three months primary treatment. My intentions were to go to a sober living environment and get used to going to NA meetings before I came back to Australia, but I got a lot more then I was hoping for
They organised transport to and from the meetings, had a well structured program to keep you busy in recovery with an abundance of exercise activities ( my favourite being the trail walking with Henk, I found my new healthy hobbie thanks to Embrace) , guided meditation, a great selection of counselors and group therapist and not to mention the support workers who were alwàys around to keep us happy and keep us safe. There was frequent drug and alcohol testing in the facility, I think this is a must in a sober house. As good as the Thai food was I made and option to cook my own food most of the time and they provide a huge kitchen with everything you will every need.

I left Embrace with around 25 NA meetings under my belt in a month  and some great connections within the NA community.

I would recommend Embrace to anyone who is serious about recovery and wants NA as apart of there program when they leave.

If your curious whether Embrace is for you, why not head over and check it out, Henk will take you on a tour show you just how good the place is. My room felt like a 5 🌟 hotel, and the property is absolutely beautiful.

Thanks to all the staff and fellow clients at Embrace you made my stay well worth the money. Thank you

I attached a photo of myself on the home stretch of a 24km trail walk/run with sully who is the fitness coach at embrace. This trail had over 1000m elevation and was probably one of the best days of my life.

I didn't know what to expect upon arriving at Embrace. I needed secondary treatment after primary. All I knew was I needed a safe environment... Embrace offered me that safe environment plus so much more.
I met some amazing people... the staff... incredibly supportive and knowledgeable. Seeing things in myself that I couldn't see. I've been to other sober houses in the past but what puts Embrace ahead of the rest is the attention given to my behaviors, my growth and my recovery. Gently pushed and motivated to try new things, to get out of my comfort zone into the 'growth zone'.. The support i received at Embrace during early recovery allowed me the time and space to get to know myself... to learn who I am in recovery.
I didn't feel like a number... I felt a part of a family. I was surrounded by healthy people serious about their recovery and that energy rubbed off on me. That is what Embrace is. A family, a community of people striving for personal growth and helping each other along the way.
The extended community beyond Embrace was not something i was expecting. Ex-clients and people connected to Embrace through strong recovery and community coming to the Embrace BBQ every Sunday and helping me see that not only recovery was possible but that I could be apart of something.... It gave me that sense of belonging i needed.
There's no opportunity to get bored at Embrace... Every day there are activities ranging from Football games, cooking classes, onsite yoga sessions, art groups, badminton, ping pong tournaments, excursions, soundbowl healing, Buddhism teaching classes, onsite quizzes, hikes, bike rides, go-karting, kayaking, bootcamps, CrossFit, amazing markets and so much more.
The location offers lovely mountain views, quiet surroundings but not far from shopping malls and amazing restaurants...
There is a wide variety of counselors available as well. Each with their own skillset and so approachable.. I feel like i was spoilt for choice.
Embrace goes to any length to ensure clients are comfortable and settled. If i had a problem i never felt like my concerns or requests fell on deaf ears. Not once.

I found myself at Embrace. I cant recommend them highly enough. Thank you Embrace.

I went Embrace for 7 months with an initial plan of staying only 2 months. I have been to other sober livings in the past and I must say, none of them have compared to the quality and care that Embrace posses. The staff care, the counselors are amazing and they have gone well beyond my expectations to help me recover and keep me safe.
As a chronic relapsing addict, I needed a strong sober community surrounded with people who really want to stay clean and improve their quality of life; and that is exactly what I found since arriving at Embrace. There are so many activities to do like meditation, yoga, weekly activities around Chiang Mai, badminton, and so many more. The fellowship of Narcotics Anonymous in Chiang Mai is phenomenal and well connected with the staff and owners of Embrace.
I highly recommend anyone who is looking for support to stay clean and improve their quality of life to go to Embrace. Thank you so much for being such a huge part of the beginning of my recovery. The foundation of recovery Embrace helped me build will hopefully carry me far into the future.

The team works hard at providing a coordinated and program of Sobriety support and training...always providing opportunities to reshape our views as to what life for us as recovering addicts can be, helping us to reshape our everyday actions and thoughts to actually achieve that new and productive vision! Extremely positive experience at Embrace! Great program, fantastic rooms and amazing staff. Embrace got me right where I needed to be in life and helped me extensively with my sobriety. A huge thank you to Henk, Mark, Dan, Sully and Phil for all their amazing help during my 3 month stay here.

Embrace changed my life, 4 years into sobriety! I found myself backsliding after a series of challenges in the past year, was losing control yet becoming more controlling than ever, a dry drunk. To the point of a physical/mental/emotional breakdown. Fortunately, somehow, I realized I was in trouble and managed to get in touch with Henk after a suggestion from a mutual friend. It’s hard to know where to start to describe my time at Embrace and everything the Embrace community has done for me. And it is a community.

After 3 months in Primary treatment at another facility in Thailand, I moved to embrace for 3 more months, and it was the best decision I could have made. History had shown me the transition from primary back to real life just hadn’t worked for me before (multiple times).

The program offered is the perfect mix of comfortable structure, and time to find your own rhythm.

I’ve never come across the balance between holistic care and exposure and a 12-step community as is seen in Chaing Mai, and at embrace you are at the center of it all.

Henk and Bill were fundamental in my way forward; with the help they quietly offered going above and beyond duty of care. You really get out, what you put in on this wild ride of recovery. I can’t thank them enough.

I am now home as the best version of myself that I could possibly hope for, for myself, my children and my future.

I cannot express how grateful I am for Embrace, its brilliant support staff, therapists, managers and partners. They were instrumental in my successful recovery, and if it wasn’t for them I’m not sure I’d be writing this review today … that is not an exaggeration. Having spent three months in primary care, a profound, chaotic and revelatory experience, my decision to come to Embrace couldn’t have been more timely. Unbeknownst to me, often the case when leaving rehabilitation, I clearly needed more support and guidance - my recovery was too fragile to return home. Embrace was the perfect balance between continued therapeutic work and the real world. You are held accountable, whilst having the freedom to reintegrate into society. An essential part of the process. It is a fact that the more time you spend in rehabilitation the more likely you are to flourish and remain sober - Embrace is the place to do this.

Embrace is the paradigm for sober living, and the foundations for a truly successful recovery are created by its indispensable program. I cannot recommend it enough.
